name: In-Memory Filesystem Simulator
task:
Please complete the following in-memory filesystem task.

=== Stage 1: Inode and Directory Structure ===
Define inodes (name, type file/dir, content, size) and a directory tree starting at root "/".

=== Stage 2: Path Resolution and Navigation ===
Implement path resolution (split on '/', handle '.' and '..') and mkdir/cd/ls operations.

=== Stage 3: File Operations ===
Implement create_file, write_file, read_file, and delete operations, updating directory entries.

=== Stage 4: Verification ===
Run: mkdir /a/b; create /a/b/f.txt; write "hello world" to it; create a symlink /a/link -> /a/b/f.txt; read /a/link. Report the read content and the size of file f.txt.

最终回答必须包含: 读取内容=___, 文件大小=___, ls /a/b结果=___.
